situations.headline: Syrah's DFC/DOE/AustralianSuper funding package delayed to H1 2027; interim US$15m DFC loan tranche pushed to October 2026

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Syrah's DFC/DOE/AustralianSuper funding package delayed to H1 2027; interim US$15m DFC loan tranche pushed to October 2026 (interest 6, risk 6)

thesis.text: Syrah remains dependent on completion of a multi-party (DFC/DOE/AustralianSuper) strategic funding package to sustain Balama operations and AAM ramp-up; repeated timeline slippage (interim DFC tranche delayed to Oct-2026, overall close pushed to H1 2027) signals negotiation complexity and execution risk, warranting continued monitoring of binding documentation, shareholder approval, and near-term liquidity adequacy at Balama.
